verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gitea can reuse existing GitHub Actions, pulled from any Git website, and can work alongside CI tools like Drone and Jenkins. None of it documents a Gitea marketplace or app directory where a developer browses and installs third-party integrations. Reusing Actions by reference, or pairing Gitea with external tools, is adjacent rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install third-party integrations from a marketplace or app directory
